spans.s:
tatá, m. father. [cf. τέττα, Lat. tata,
‘papa’: Eng. dad, though of similar
make, has of course no direct connection.]

tāta, m. used in voc. s., to a father, but generally
to a junior or an inferior, my dear.
[cf. tata.]

tat-kṣaṇa, m. that moment; -am, adv.
in that moment, straightway. [tad.]

tattva, n. (that-ness, i. e.) essence, real
condition or state of a thing. [tad.]

tattva-jña, a. knowing the essence or
the truth or what's what.

tat-para, a. having that as highest object;
 given over to, intent upon. [tad.]

tátra, adv.
 —1. (as synonymous w. loc. of
tad in all numbers and genders) in or among
or on this or these or them, 13^7, 21^8, 38^11,
57^22; in this matter, 37^8; herein, 98^2;
 —2. there, often, e. g. 2^8, 5^6; thither, 6^6,
11^14, etc.; correl. w. yatra, 24^4;
 —3. on
that occasion, in that case, then, 4^1, 14^22,
40^1. [pron. root ta, 497, 1099.]

tat-samīpe, adv. near him. [tad: see
samīpa.]
